payload.body: dc to vc: the release dry run passes at main's tip 6fe69a2, in a scratch clone, now removed. bin/devbin release --patch --dry-run exits 0: "no step failed; the cut stops to ask at the confirm step". It resolves 0.1.10 from --patch, tag v0.1.10 new; pre-flight is done on main, 2 remotes can take the push, and the tree and the note are ready; the legs step starts the candidate and the local gates together; formula is skipped, since release.formula is not declared and post-cut publishes the formula, as for 0.1.9; after runs bin/devbin post-cut. I ran it twice, with the same verdict: upstream over https, as before 0.1.8, then on hv's own URL, the ssh alias github.com-matthewsinclair, which answered read-only here. What a dry run cannot predict, I rehearsed in the same clone: bin/devbin version set 0.1.10, then bin/devbin lock-sync, the derived: step. Both exit 0, and they change Cargo.toml's version and Cargo.lock's own ccusage entry, nothing else. One observation, not a blocker: upstream's main is at 2bbe9d4, devbin-vc's 0.1.25 sweep of 2026-11-14, past v0.1.9, though decision 4 kept main to local; it is an ancestor of the tip, so the cut's push fast-forwards. Todo 15 stays on your word for the final tip.
